title: Grade 2 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #13

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

2. Which response best shows understanding of Dua before and after waking up.? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dua before and after waking up..
   B. Apply the teaching of Dua before and after waking up. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Dua before and after waking up. has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Dua before and after waking up. to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   D. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals? (1 mark)
   A. Say Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Iman? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Iman.
   B. Use Hadith on Iman to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Iman with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on Iman has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Arabic alphabet? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Arabic alphabet.
   B. Apply the teaching of Arabic alphabet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Arabic alphabet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Arabic alphabet has no place in daily life.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hadith on swalah has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on swalah.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Love? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Love.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Love with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on Love to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on Love has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   B. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on swalah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Iman and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Love and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Pillars of Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

2. B — Apply the teaching of Dua before and after waking up. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. B — Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. D — Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Apply the teaching of Environment 6.3.1 Care for domestic animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Iman with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Apply the teaching of Arabic alphabet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

9. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith on swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

11. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Love with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadith on swalah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadith on Iman; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadith on Love; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Pillars of Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
